feature: Launch epic F3: the public card and commander pages, signed out (PR 2a/2b: the card page and its not-found)
note: No sign-in: `signedOut` photographs the pages as a visitor gets them. Their CONTENT is the same signed in (nothing in it reads a session), but the shell around it is not, so these rows are signed out. Each card is addressed by its bare 12-hex id, which 308s to the canonical address before the wait. Serve with PUBLIC_PAGES_ENABLED=true. The commander page's rows (B1 to B4) belong to F3 PR 3.

rows.label: A1 /card Rootha: one face, its image over its own wash, rules, facts, one printing, the signed-out block
A2 /card Valki: two faces, both names and type lines, the // rule in the rules text, the turn control under the card
A3 /card Ghalta: many printings; at 390 the chips collapse to 8 and end in Show all
A4 /card Sol Ring: capped printings (first 40); at 390 Show all 40 here, at 1300 all 40 and More on Scryfall
C3 /card unknown id: the top bar with the Scryfall link, 404, the shipped heading and caption, ONE Back home, no View decks
